cause_quote: The diff added `void host.loadMoreSidebarSessions();` to the enabled sidebar button while adding `owner.sessionsLoading ||` to the guard that returns before requesting a page.
user_saw: During a sidebar refresh, users could click the enabled Load more sessions button and no new page would load.
summary: The fix uses the sidebar controller’s loading state to disable the Load more sessions button and mark it busy during a refresh.
reasoning: The parent’s section control only revealed rows already loaded, and #115110 introduced server-backed sidebar pagination with an enabled button and a controller that rejected clicks during refresh. I checked that the loading guard survived the filtered-list refactor and that #131202 carried the mismatch into the dedicated roster button. The later bulk-deletion flow exposed the same mismatch during a refresh of the selected agent’s filtered list.
